backend/main.mo: Main canister logic providing access-controlled profile management and Valentine day claiming using Map storage and helper functions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module passing old actor state through unchanged since no structural changes exist.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling defining Valentine-themed OKLCH color variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app and mounting it on the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling access gate, profile setup, and rendering progress and daily experience once loaded.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessGateS: Full-screen unlock screen prompting users to enter the correct secret phrase to access the app.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Placeholder for login/logout button code; file is present but content not provided.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting the user to enter their name and saving it via useSaveCallerUserProfile.
frontend/src/components/valentine/ClaimT: Button to claim the current Valentine day, handling success, errors, and already-claimed states.
frontend/src/components/valentine/DailyE: Renders the appropriate daily Valentine experience based on date, including pre-week, active days, or final messages.
frontend/src/components/valentine/flower: CSS for floating animated flower icons with hover, focus, and reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Flower: Displays floating clickable icons tied to each Valentine day that show a random pickup line when clicked.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Pickup: Dialog overlay showing the selected pickup line with themed styling.
frontend/src/components/valentine/SevenD: Shows progress across the 7 Valentine days with badges, icons, and a progress bar using user claim data.
frontend/src/components/valentine/valent: CSS for the full‑screen Valentine celebration view with animated hearts and responsive text.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Valent: Special Valentine’s Day card asking a question and showing an animated celebration when answered.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccessGate.ts: Hook managing a localStorage‑based access gate requiring a specific code to unlock.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and managing the backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshing dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useClaimToday.ts: Provides a mutation hook to call actor.claimDay and invalidate valentineData on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useClientId.ts: Generates or retrieves a persistent client ID from localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and saves the caller's user profile using react-query with actor-based API calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, and identity loading logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file exporting nothing, noting where feature-specific hooks live.
frontend/src/hooks/useValentineClaims.ts: Queries user Valentine claim data via actor.getUserValentineData with react-query.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind styles and custom Valentine-themed color variables and background pattern.
frontend/src/lib/pickupLines.ts: Contains themed pickup lines and a helper to fetch a random line with optional day filtering.
frontend/src/lib/valentineDates.ts: Computes Valentine Week status and whether it's Valentine's Day based on current date.
frontend/src/lib/valentineWeek.ts: Defines Valentine Week day metadata and helpers to retrieve days by name or index.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, extending theme colors, radii, shadows, animations, and fonts, and loading typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a Valentine‑week app, its flow, gating method, required assets, and a list of existing features with architectural notes.
